mapper.select: SELECT t.user_id userId, ptcn.trip_type tripType, ptcn.`no` FROM pubcar_trip t LEFT JOIN pubcar_trip_car_num ptcn ON ptcn.trip_id = t.trip_id WHERE t.trip_id = #{tripId}
mapper.insert: insert into business_pubcar_trip_car_num(b_id, num_id, trip_type, passenger_num, car_id, driver_id, no, trip_id, operate, is_self) values (#{bId}, #{numId}, #{tripType}, #{passengerNum}, #{carId}, #{driverId}, #{no}, #{tripId}, #{operate}, #{isSelf})
